subject: oop
question: What is the purpose of the package keyword in Java?
title: Package = Folder
hook: Two classes called Student in one drawer. Which one is it?
answer: A package groups related classes and interfaces into one named namespace.
It prevents name conflicts: shop.Student and school.Student can coexist.
It controls access (default / package-private visibility) and makes classes easy to find and reuse.
It must be the first statement in the source file: package shop;
